description: This file defines the MBPackageTree class, which manages a tree structure representing packages in the ModuleBuilder component of SuiteCRM. It includes functions to build, populate, and fetch the tree data, and relies on external Tree and Node classes.

classes.name: MBPackageTree
classes.description: A class to create and manage a tree structure of packages within SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the package tree and populates it with nodes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name for the package tree.

methods.name: populateTree
methods.description: Recursively populates the tree with nodes based on provided node data.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Returns the array representation of the tree nodes.

methods.name: fetchNodes
methods.description: Returns the raw node data of the tree.
